---
title: Bad sections
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    sections: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        errors: strict
    typst:
      shouldError: true
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: '\[typst-extras\] sections: unsupported value true'
